articles.title: Zircon Ring
articles.intro: Level-54 ring for all jobs: INT +3 and Ice resistance +7.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

Goldsmithing 75: Earth Crystal + one Gold Ring + one Zircon. Zircon Ring is the ordinary result; high-quality results are Genius Ring or Genius Ring +1. A second recipe uses Gold Ring +1 at Goldsmithing 80.

Buy the finished ring under Auction House → Armor → Rings.

articles.title: Sea Puk
articles.intro: Original ToAU Puks found in Mamook and Bhaflau Thickets.
articles.body_html:
Where

Mamook: levels 76–78. Bhaflau Thickets: levels 77–78. These are ordinary outdoor/dungeon enemies, not a forced-spawn NM.

Blue Magic

  1. Fight one on Blue Mage and let it use Zephyr Mantle.
  2. Defeat it while eligible to learn the spell; repeat if learning fails. Zephyr Mantle becomes usable at BLU 65.

Avoid Wind damage: the Puk family absorbs it. Watch for area knockback and Flash.

articles.title: Chamnaet Spring
articles.intro: Target used to fill the Cotton Pouch during Zephyr Fan acquisition.
articles.body_html:
Steps

  1. Get a Cotton Pouch from Zebada near the Uleguerand Range entrance.
  2. Climb to the western slope. Slide down toward the southern ledge above the bottom and enter its cave.
  3. Trade the pouch to Chamnaet Spring to receive Chamnaet Ice.
  4. Take the ice back to Zebada for Zephyr Fan.

The fan is the entry key item for the Bearclaw Pinnacle ENMs. Open your chosen battlefield guide for its separate entrance route.

articles.title: First Rampart
articles.intro: Floor-four Rampart in the original Zhayolm Remnants.
articles.body_html:
Progression

Choose this Rampart if your group entered Zhayolm Remnants on Firesday or Earthsday. The entry day determines the correct target, not the current day when you reach it. Defeating the correct target opens the route to floor five.

Fight and loot

It can summon a Rogue Marid. A possible drop is Zhayolm Card. Choose the right Rampart before attacking; the wrong choice can send the group around floor four again.

articles.title: Devilet
articles.intro: Imp enemies with route-opening roles in the original Silver Sea Remnants.
articles.body_html:
Third-floor north route

  1. Use a northern teleporter from floor two of Silver Sea Remnants.
  2. Defeat the fast-moving Devilet in the northern room. It repeatedly disengages and resumes its patrol as it loses HP; pursue and defeat it.
  3. Its defeat unlocks progression and reveals the Slot. Trade Zhayolm Card there to spawn Don Poroggo.

Second-floor southeast route

Four Devilets must be defeated to open that wing’s teleporter. Do not confuse these with the separately named Deadpan Devilet on the northwest route.

articles.title: Wake the Puppet
articles.intro: Second Lieutenant Assault in Periqia: return at least four of six automatons within 30 minutes.
articles.body_html:
Start

Take orders from Lageegee in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and enter from Dvucca Isle Staging Point. Original party requirement: 3–6; recommended level 70.

Steps

  1. Search the four dead-end rooms north, south, east and west of Adeeha. Three rooms contain two automatons each.
  2. Target one and use /salute. Each player controls one puppet.
  3. Stay within 10 yalms and repeatedly /clap to move it toward you. Wights appear after activation; protect your puppet.
  4. If it stops to emote, answer using the table below.
  5. Beside Adeeha, use /goodbye. Its name turns green when successfully returned.
  6. Repeat for four puppets; then use the Rune of Release. Returning all six improves points.

Response table

Puppet actionYour response
Blushing/doze
Bowing/kneel
Cheering/psych
Confused/slap
Clapping/angry
Dancing/joy
Happy/smile
Pointing/no
Praising/blush
Saluting/praise
Shocked/comfort
Waving/welcome

Rewards

Periqia Assault Points and appraisal items. A ??? Sash can become Zeta Sash.
